label: prf:categorical-q-ext-deriv-exists
title: Proof of existence of the categorical $q$-exterior derivative
html: We build d_q as a scalar-weighted linear combination of the categorical de Rham differential d and its vertical projection \pi_V \circ d. d \colon \Omega^k(A) \to \Omega^{k+1}(A) is the non-commutative de Rham differential, part of the categorical connection data. \pi_V is a morphism by the weight decomposition. The scalar q^{-1} and (1 - q^{-1}) act via the substrate parameter, and scalar multiplication and addition of morphisms exist in any R-linear category. The composite d_q is therefore a morphism in \mathbf{C}.
